verdict: ANNIHILATION_TO_RADIATION: a dynamical particle-antiparticle experiment on the QNG phi-soliton. (A) A vortex(+1)+antivortex(-1) pair ATTRACTS and ANNIHILATES -- defect count 2 -> 0, defect spread 14 -> 0 lu (net topological charge 0, conserved through to 0). (B) The annihilation RELEASES the energy as outgoing phi-WAVES: the outer-annulus (r>L/3) energy rises from 2.53 to 4.23 as the radiation front propagates out at ~c_phi. So the QNG soliton shows genuine matter-antimatter -> radiation: the particle and antiparticle annihilate (topological charge -> 0) and their rest energy escapes as massless phi-radiation at c -- exactly the particle-physics phenomenology, here a dynamical substrate behavior (not assumed). On a torus the net winding must be 0, so this +1/-1 pair is the clean experiment; like-charge repulsion needs compensating defects (4-body). This is the U(1) phi-vortex (baby-Skyrmion); the SU(2) Skyrmion baryon would annihilate similarly with richer (pion-radiation) structure.
